data: Which BioASQ test set has the highest micro f-measure for the average of all participating systems?

The question asks which BioASQ test set has the highest micro f-measure for the average of all participating systems. From the caption, we know that the average micro f-measure is represented by the green line labeled 'Avg'. By visually inspecting the graph, we can see that the green line reaches its peak in BioASQ7. Therefore, the answer is BioASQ7.
